Explanation:  
The question asks which country were the holders of the FIFA World Cup the last time a London club won the UEFA Champions League, as of August 1, 2024. The most recent UEFA Champions League win by a London club was by Chelsea in 2021, when France were the FIFA World Cup holders (having won in 2018). The Predicted Answer claims the last win was in 2012 and states that Spain was the World Cup holder (from 2010), which is incorrect—the most recent is 2021, with France as reigning champions during that time. Thus, the Predicted Answer does not contain the correct ground truth information.

Decision: FALSE
